Research Programmes Admission Guide
Students are required to pursue an independent but supervised research on an approved topic based on which a thesis must be submitted for examination. Students are also required to attend classes and pass the examinations.
APPLY NOW (For August 2027 intake)
CHECK STATUS
We welcome graduates with strong academic potential and a passion for research to apply for NTU’s postgraduate research programmes. To support a holistic and evidence-based evaluation, applicants are required to submit the following documents and demonstrate the following competencies:
Academic Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree: A strong Bachelor’s degree with minimum Honours (Distinction) and its equivalent.
Master’s Degree (where applicable)
English Language Proficiency: A good TOEFL/IELTS score for applicants whose Bachelor’s degree is not conducted in English.
-Validity: Test scores must be within 2 years from the date of application.
Research Potential and Motivation
Research Proposal (where applicable): A well-developed proposal that reflects research interests, potential, and motivation.
Resume: A resume that highlights personal and academic achievements, prior research experience and skills, leadership and character.
Personal Statement: A narrative outlining the applicant’s academic journey, research interests, and goals.
Abstracts of Research Publications (where applicable)
Academic References: Two academic references providing insights into the applicant’s academic capabilities and character.
Test Scores (where applicable)
GRE / GMAT / GATE are optional*.
- Strong evidence of quantitative, verbal, and/or analytical skills through these tests will enhance your application.
Validity
GRE / GMAT: Within 5 years from the date of application;
GATE (for applicants from India): Minimum 90th percentile, within 3 years from the date of application
*Some programmes may still require these test scores. Please refer to the admission requirement of the respective programme here.
Video Essay (for programmes under the College of Engineering, College of Science, and Interdisciplinary Graduate Programme): Applicants are required to submit a short video presentation as part of their application.
Candidature Periods
For higher degrees by research, candidates may be admitted as full-time or part-time students. The minimum and maximum periods of candidature for both full-time and part-time are as follows:

All applications must be submitted through the current Application Portal. Applications submitted through any previous application portal will not be accepted or considered.
Application Period
There are two intakes each year - August or January. Applicants are advised to submit their application before the last day of submission for the desired intake.
Intake in August or January is subjected to the school’s
selection and recommendation. The University reserves the right to admit applicants in other semesters.
For applicants interested in NIE programmes, please apply at https://ntu.sg/NIEGradProgIntake.

Supporting Documents
You must upload electronic copies of your supporting documents to the application portal. Documents uploaded must be in English. Otherwise, they must be accompanied by certified translations in English language. Please upload outstanding documents to the application portal.
An application fee of S$50 (Nett) will be charged for each Research application. Payment can be made online before submitting application by VISA/Mastercard.

General Information on Supporting Documents
Identification documents:
Singapore Citizens: Scanned copy of NRIC
Permanent Residents: Scanned copy of NRIC & Re-Entry Permit
International Applicants: Scanned copy of Passport
Test Scores (where applicable):
TOEFL/ IELTS (Validity of 2 years at point of application)

Education Qualifications: (in both original language and English translation)
Bachelor’s Degree
Degree Certificate
Official Transcript (with grading system and honours classification details included)
Official translation in English (if original is not in English)
Master’s Degree (where applicable)
Degree Certificate
Official Transcript (with grading system and honours classification details included)
Official translation in English (if original is not in English)
(Translation can be done by the Home University or any official authorized parties)
Note on Official Transcript
A copy of official transcript with detailed academic results (marks obtained in each subject, not just grades obtained, wherever possible) is required from each university attended. It should show the university name with the official stamp or it should be certified and translated by the university.
If the transcript is in a language other than English, please provide an official English translation as well and the subjects in the translation should be listed in the same order as that of the original transcript (label the transcript if need be).
The applicant is responsible for requesting transcripts from his/her university or universities.
Two Referees' Reports
Application must be supported by two (2) referee reports.
Provide the name, reference type and institutional email addresses of two (2) referees.
The Referee email address must be an Official institutional email address. Email address given by the free-email provider will not be accepted (i.e. email address given by hotmail, gmail, yahoo, qq, etc).
Upon submission of the referees’ details, it will auto-activate an email to the respective Referee to notify them to complete an online Referee Report. Do ask your Referee to look out for the email in inbox/ junk mail and complete it within 14 working days upon receipt.
You may check the status of their submission via the application portal.
You may click on the “Recommendations Page” to send a reminder to your referee(s).
Other Supporting documents (where applicable)
Research proposal
Resume
Research publications

Notes on Application
Application will be reviewed upon
Successful payment of application fee of SGD50 (nett), and
All required supporting documents.
Application fee payment is non-transferable and non-refundable.
Complete set of supporting documents (must be legible) have to be uploaded via the application portal. Late submission will not be accepted. The School may contact applicants for additional information or documents at a later date (if required).
Applications will be deemed invalid and will not be processed if payment is not made by the stipulated deadline and applicants will have re-submit a new application as a fresh applicant. No further notification will be sent.
